Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.Why Tanso?• Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.• Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.• Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.• Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.• AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.• Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.Your roleTo build the engine that lets Customer Success scale, we are looking for a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager (f/m/x) .As a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager, you will shape how Customer Success works at Tanso, from operating model and data to tooling, automation and scaled customer formats. Working closely with our Head of CS, you take ideas from concept to hands-on execution and make every CSM more impactful: more customers served, more value delivered, targets hit.Key responsibilities• Strategy & Operations: You shape how Customer Success operates. Together with the Head of CS, you continuously sharpen our operating model (segmentation, lifecycle, playbooks) and OKR/goal process – and bring it to life, from concept to rollout. As the central link to Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Climate Intelligence, you make sure everything we build and do is aligned on customer value.• Tooling & Process Excellence: You keep the CS engine running and make it run smarter. You own and build our tech stack hands-on (HubSpot, Intercom, no-/low-code) and use automation and AI to free up CSMs to focus on what matters most: our customers.• Scaled Engagement & Enablement: You help CS scale. You build and run 1:n formats such as Tanso Academy, Tanso Update and our customer advisory board, and grow our customer community. With playbooks and templates, you enable CSMs to serve more customers without compromising on quality.• Projects & Strategic Initiatives: You turn ideas into impact. You lead cross-functional CS projects from concept to execution: pilot fast, measure impact, then scale or kill.Your profile• You have experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations or consulting, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.• You think in data: you build dashboards and analyses that answer real questions, and translate insights into clear priorities and actions.• You are hands-on with tools. You have worked with CRM and customer engagement platforms (ideally HubSpot and Intercom), enjoy building automations with no-/low-code tools, and are curious about using AI in daily work.• You have led cross-functional projects end to end and know how to align stakeholders across multiple departments.• You combine structured, strategic thinking with a pragmatic drive to get things done. You spot problems early, take ownership and see solutions through.• You communicate clearly and confidently, whether you’re writing a playbook or aligning with leadership.• You're business-fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.• You're based in Munich or willing to relocate.Nice to Have• Experience with scaled CS programs (webinars, academies, communities).• Interest in sustainability and carbon accounting.What we offer• A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth.• Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed.• A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security.• Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development.• Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options.• Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences.Our teamWe're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.About usTanso is an integrated sustainability software for carbon accounting and ESG data management. Our goal is to help manufacturing companies meet regulatory requirements and achieve their sustainability objectives.TansoWorking at Tanso

jobs.occupation: Account Manager, Public Sector – German-Speaking (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Why we need youMaltego is a tool used globally by industry experts, analysts, and law enforcement agencies to help protect and watch-over their own infrastructure but also to keep guard on internet safety, reduce crime and catch bad guys.As an Account Manager, you will act as a trusted advisor and customer advocate at Maltego, helping customers in our scaled-touch portfolio achieve success and maximize the value of their investment. Your main focus will be to own the commercial relationship, drive adoption and retention, ensure successful renewals, and identify up- and cross-sell opportunities. You will work closely with Enablement, Data Hub, Sales, and Marketing to understand our product roadmap, share customer feedback, and ensure relevant updates reach customers in a clear and timely way.What to expectYour responsibilities will include:• Own and manage a scaled-touch account portfolio, ensuring consistent customer engagement, portfolio health, and commercial performance.• Manage the customer journey from onboarding and adoption to renewal and expansion, balancing scalable engagement with targeted high-impact touchpoints.• Develop and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers, practitioners, and key stakeholders across government accounts and related organizations.• Proactively identify customer risks by monitoring portfolio metrics, product usage, renewal signals, and customer feedback, and develop practical mitigation plans.• Identify growth opportunities within your portfolio to drive up- and cross-sell and strategically grow the account.• Create and execute lightweight account plans and success plans that support value realization, retention, and expansion across a larger account base.• Work closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Success Services, Product, and Enablement to ensure customer satisfaction, timely issue resolution, and scalable customer success.Your profile in short• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, ideally with a background or strong interest in OSINT, cybersecurity, law enforcement, public sector, or trust and safety.• 3+ years of experience in a B2B Account Management, Customer Success, or commercial customer-facing role, preferably in software, cybersecurity, OSINT, or investigations technology.• Proven experience working with government, public sector, law enforcement, intelligence, defense, or similarly regulated customers is required.• You understand the needs of scaled-touch customers and can prioritize effectively across a broad portfolio while still creating meaningful customer outcomes.• You bring strong communication skills, both in writing and in customer conversations, and can clearly articulate value to technical users, business stakeholders, and decision-makers.• You are familiar with cybersecurity, OSINT, investigations, or threat intelligence use cases and are motivated to support customers working in mission-critical environments.• You seek opportunities with a business and sales mind-set to find win/win solutions and grow the pie• You have an affinity for software tools and experience using Microsoft Office, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and Account Management or Customer Success tools.• Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), additional European languages are a plusWhy you will love MaltegoMaltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations, coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego:• Make an impact: Work in a scale-up environment with the opportunity to take ownership and make a direct, lasting contribution.• 30 days of paid vacation to relax, recharge, and enjoy life outside of work• Your wellbeing matters: Access mental health support and 1:1 sessions with certified psychologists through Nilo• Keep learning: Maltego supports your development, including subsidies for eligible language courses• Connect beyond the day-to-day: Join company events and celebrations that bring our international community together.• Collaborate with talented and mission-driven teams across the business.At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.LocationBased in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in the officeRequired documents / informationReady to help drive the future of digital investigations? Apply now with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your experience!About usMaltego is the all-in-one investigation platform that accelerates complex cyber and OSINT investigations from hours to minutes. The Maltego platform powers preliminary quick OSINT investigations for digital profiling with Maltego Search as well as complex link analysis for large datasets with Maltego Graph. Through Maltego Evidence and Maltego Monitor, the platform enables investigators to collect, monitor, and preserve social media intelligence in real-time for prosecution and public safety. Whether cyber threat intelligence teams or law enforcement, Maltego equips your teams with the most essential and relevant data, with out-of-the-box access to common data sources and over 100 ready-made connectors to more. Mine, merge, and map all your essential intelligence in one place, and uncover hidden truths with Maltego!Learn more about how we can empower your investigations at www.maltego.com.

jobs.occupation: PostDoc Agentic AI and Predictive Technologies (IT-Lösungsentwickler/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionBoehringer Ingelheim is seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Scientist to advance the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Agentic AI systems, and predictive computational technologies in late-stage pharmaceutical development. The position focuses on transforming the development of solid oral dosage forms through the integration of mechanistic modeling, hybrid digital twins, advanced analytics, and autonomous AI-driven development workflows.As successful candidate, you will work in a highly motivated, small team of experienced prediction technology experts directly integrated into daily development business. You will be able to integrate your academic knowledge and further broaden your expertise. The work will be at the intersection of pharmaceutical sciences, process engineering, data science, and artificial intelligence. The overall objective is to establish next-generation computational frameworks that accelerate process understanding, optimization, scale-up, technology transfer, and commercial manufacturing readiness.This role provides a unique opportunity to shape how AI and autonomous scientific agents are applied across the pharmaceutical development lifecycle and to contribute to the future of digital and data-driven CMC development.This position is limited for 2 years.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.This Position is limited for 2 years.Note: To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- One of your key responsibilities will be to develop predictive models and hybrid digital twins for pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.- In regard to process understanding and optimization, you will apply mechanistic modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytics to support scale-up and technology transfer activities.- Moreover, you will design and implement Agentic AI and multi-agent systems to support scientific decision-making, experimental planning, knowledge extraction, and process optimization.- In addition, you will evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for their application in pharmaceutical development.- Furthermore, you will generate scientific insights that contribute to improved process performance, robustness, and efficiency across development and manufacturing.- You will be a contact person for cross-functional collaboration with formulation scientists, process engineers, manufacturing experts, and data scientists in multidisciplinary project teams.﻿Requirements- PhD in Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Systems Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related scientific discipline.- Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas: pharmaceutical process development, mathematical modeling, machine learning and artificial intelligence, or process systems engineering.- Experience with scientific programming languages such as Python and the ability to work with complex datasets and computational tools.- Ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary and international research teams.- Fluent English communication skills; willingness to learn German.- Knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and familiarity with mechanistic, data-driven, or hybrid modeling approaches. Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, or multi-agent systems is considered an advantage.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.occupation: Global Regulatory Strategy Lead (Director Regulatory Affairs (Pharma/Life Science))
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionWe are seeking a dynamic individual to provide global strategic regulatory guidance and leadership throughout the product lifecycle on assigned projects. In this pivotal role, you will develop and be accountable for the Global Regulatory Strategy of your projects lead the Regulatory Excellence Team (RET) and represent Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) on the Evidence Team (aka the cross-functional project Team).This position can be filled in different countries.If you want to apply for the position in the US, please use this link: 'coming soon'If you want to apply for the position in Germany, click "Apply now"Tasks & responsibilities- As a regulatory professional, you will contribute to a holistic global strategy for assigned Inflammation projects. Your leadership and in-depth expertise will enable you to interact seamlessly at all levels of the organization, drive project goals, and maintain the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and regulatory compliance.- You will lead the development and implementation of cutting-edge global strategic regulatory strategies. Your role will involve assessing regulatory risks, proposing innovative solutions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to align regulatory strategies with business objectives.- As the main GRA representative on the Evidence Team, you will ensure that regulatory considerations are incorporated timely and comprehensively in the decision-making process.- You will lead the Regulatory Excellence Team (RET) for assigned projects, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous learning. Your role will involve mentoring team members, identifying training needs, and promoting a proactive and solution-oriented approach.- In collaboration with Brand & Evidence teams and Global Labelling, you will shape early target label profiles and oversee the planning, preparation, and execution of regulatory submissions. Your role will also involve supporting submission rollout for Rest of World (RoW) countries from a global strategic perspective.Requirements- High level of education in pharmacy, life sciences, or chemistry, ideally holding a Master's or Doctoral Degree. Additional certifications such as Specialized Pharmacist, Master of Drug Regulatory Affairs, or RAC are highly desirable- In-depth knowledge of Regulatory Affairs across multiple regions, including the US and/or EU. You have a proven track record of developing and implementing successful regulatory strategies, ideally with preparation of IND, (s)BLA/(s)NDA and/or MAA, Health Authority meeting briefing documents and negotiating with Health Authority(ies) in a major market (e.g. US, EU)- Regulatory experience in one or several of Boehringer Ingelheim's Therapeutic Areas is preferred, and experience outside of Regulatory Affairs, e.g. in Clinical Development and R&D will be considered a valuable asset- Proven ability to interpret and translate complex scientific data and regulatory guidelines into project-specific proposals. You should have commercial awareness and a thorough understanding of the business environment- Strong critical thinking and strategic mindset, with the ability to anticipate both opportunities and challenges in execution. You should excel at problem-solving, decision-making, and developing realistic action plans to achieve specific goals- Excellent leadership, team management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, lead, and inspire cross-functional teams. You should have strong interpersonal skills, relationship building, and conflict management skills, combined with excellent English skillsAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process.
